content: Yesu ꞌina liꞌu
Yoni ꞌina tuta hesedaseda ꞌoina toloina ꞌaigeda madouna sanina Sisa Ogusito ꞌimiyamiya, ma ꞌina loina ꞌilaguya ma ꞌabehega gogo ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda tomotaedi sanidiyao sileledi.
Loinaina ꞌihegaina tutaina Kuwilinio ꞌina tuta hetoloina Siliya ꞌoina.
Coinega tomota mabwaiyadi sitauya ꞌasa tamadiya ma ꞌane sanidiyao sileledi.
Yosepa wete Nasaletega ꞌitoholowa, beno Galili ꞌalonega, ma ꞌitauya Yudiya, Debida ꞌina gogo sanina Bedeliyema ꞌoina, weyahina Yosepa tauna Debida ꞌina susu ꞌaigeda.
Coinega Meli mahetena sitauya ma ꞌabehega nobwa sanidi sileledi, ma Meliina magamwagamwana.
Ma tutaina Bedeliyema ꞌoina simiyamiya ma ꞌina waiꞌena ꞌiloba pwaiya ta ꞌihenatuna,
ꞌoinega gwamaina ꞌaleꞌowega ꞌiwaduya ma hebai ꞌidi ꞌebeꞌai ꞌoina ꞌilaguya. Weyahina hada taumana ꞌimaha pwaiya, ta geya ꞌaigeda wete sawasawahina ma ꞌoina siluhu.
Sipi ꞌadi toꞌitayahinao Yesu sihaboꞌeneya
Ma tupwaina ꞌoina sipi ꞌadi toꞌitayahinao hinuwana siꞌoꞌoyatola pwatula, ma ꞌidi sipiyao siꞌitaꞌita yahidi,
ma Bada ꞌina anelose ꞌiloheꞌate yohodiya ma ꞌina ꞌasilalega mabwaiyadi simatauta.
Coinega aneloseina ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Sahena wamatamatauta, ma hesi wayaliyaya, weyahina wasa bwebweꞌana yaꞌeweyama ꞌoimiya, ma nata tomota mabwaiyadi wete ꞌidi ꞌebe yaliyaya.
Ma wasaina bewa, nige hinuwanaina Debida ꞌina ꞌasa, ꞌami Toꞌabihetenaina ꞌiliꞌuwa, Tauna ꞌida Bada Keliso.
Coinega ꞌana ꞌebe loꞌinanaina bewa, ma ꞌeguma gwamaina ꞌaleꞌo ꞌoinega siwaduya ma hebai ꞌidi ꞌebeꞌai ꞌoina ꞌiꞌenoꞌeno waloba, tauna tuwa beno gwamaina.”
Ma tutaina ꞌoina anelose wete baibaiwadi galewega sihuhulaima, ma Yehoba sihehepwatuwe,
sigwaegwae,

content.text: “Yehoba galewa tahepwatuwe, ma baleꞌuwa taudi ꞌihelauwediya simiya yaliyaya.”

content: Cigumwala ma aneloseyedi sihila pwaiya galewa, ma sipi ꞌadi toꞌitayahinao siboidimo ꞌoidiya sigwae, “Bedeliyema ꞌoina tatauya ma ginaulaina Bada ꞌihepwaileya taꞌita.”
Coinega silomwayamwayauwa ma sitauya, ma Meli ma Yosepa ta wete gwamaina hebai ꞌidi ꞌebeꞌai ꞌoina ꞌiꞌenoꞌeno silobeya.
Nage ꞌoina siꞌiteya ma gwamaina tamana ma sinana sihegwaediya toꞌaha gide anelose ꞌina gwae ꞌoidiya gwamaina weyahina.
Ma tupwana tomota wete wasaina sihesagoheya ta nuwadi ꞌihenainaida toꞌitayahi sipiyedi ꞌidi gwaeina weyahina.
Ta Meli gwaeyedi mabwaiyadi ꞌinuwatuhu yahidiya ma nuwana ꞌihenetediya weyahidi.
Coinega toꞌitayahi sipiyedi sihila ma maꞌidi hepwatu Yehoba sanina siꞌabilagasiya, weyahina anelose ꞌina hepwaila ꞌoidiya ꞌana moisa sihesagoheya, ma wete siꞌiteya.
Ma ꞌina wiki ꞌaigeda ꞌigumwala pwaiya, ma gwamaina ꞌina ꞌebeselolo ꞌwapina siꞌupwa yauleya ma sihesaniyeya Yesu, sanina beno mwalo anelose Meli ꞌiꞌebwaeya tutaina ꞌabwa geya ꞌigamwa.
Yesu sitoeya Hada Heꞌasisi* ꞌalona
Ma ꞌina tuꞌwau mulina Meli ꞌana ꞌabiheꞌehau ꞌana tuta ꞌilobeya, ta natudiuina sitoeya sihaneya Yelusalema, ma ꞌane gwamaina siꞌebwayae Yehoba ꞌoina gide Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌabehega sipaihowa.
Yehoba ꞌina loinaina bewa gide sileleya, ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Gwagwama toliꞌu nugeta meloheyadi watagwaledi Bada ꞌoina.”

content: Ma wete taudi ꞌidi pwaoli Yehoba weyahina sitauyedi, gidemusa ꞌina loina ꞌilaguya, ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Cimi pwaoli bunetutu ꞌeluwa bo gabubu ꞌeluwa.”

content: Simioni ꞌina gwae

Ma nage tutaina ꞌoina Yelusalema ꞌoina ꞌaigeda bada sanina Simioni ꞌimiyamiya. Tauna loheya bwebweꞌana, ma wete Yehoba ꞌiheꞌasisiyaneya madouna, ma ꞌiyamwayamwa meIsileli ꞌadi Toꞌabihetena weyahina. Loheyaina Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya.
Ma Yaluyaluwa Tabunaina ꞌiheꞌiteya ma ꞌabehega sahena ꞌiꞌamaꞌamasa ma ꞌana siga Toꞌabihetenaina Yehoba ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌita nugeta.
Ma Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌihenuwa laguweya, ma Simioniina ꞌiluhuwa Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌoina, ta Yosepa ma Meli gwamaina Yesu siꞌahaliyama Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌoina, ma weyahina sipaihowa gide loina ꞌina hepwaila.
Coinega Simioni gwamaina ꞌiꞌahaliya ma Yehoba ꞌoina ꞌiloyauwedowa, ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Bada, ꞌino gwae hemisa ꞌoiguwa yaloba pwaiya, ꞌoinega bewa tuwa ꞌutagwalegau ma maꞌigu yaliyaya yaꞌamasa,
bewa Tauna ꞌulagu latuheya mabwaiyama ꞌoima,
ta taudi ganamuli ꞌidi Toꞌabiheꞌasilala, ma tauma ꞌino tomota meIsileli ꞌima ꞌebe hepwatu.”

content: Ma tamana ma sinana nuwadi ꞌihepwanopwanowa ꞌina gwaeyedi natudiu weyahina.
Coinega Simioni ꞌigwae helauwediya, ta ꞌigwae Meli ꞌoina, tauna Yesu sinana, ma ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Cuꞌita gwama bewa Yehoba ꞌihesinuweya ma ꞌoinega ꞌabwa meIsileli tupwana baibaiwadi ꞌiꞌabihe beꞌudi, ma tupwana baibaiwadi ꞌiꞌabihe toholodi, ma tauna tuwa ꞌabwa ꞌiheꞌilaꞌilala tomota ꞌoidiya, ma tupwadi siꞌahwa ꞌaboꞌabowe,
ma ꞌoinega ꞌidi nuwatuhu dahwadahwaidi ꞌiꞌabi latuhedi. Ma ꞌowa Meli nata ꞌino nuwagala gide suna ꞌibadibadigo.”

content: Ana ꞌina gwae

Nage ꞌoina ꞌaigeda wahine topalopisai ꞌimiyamiya, sanina Ana, tauna Penuwela natuna, ma wete Aseli ꞌina susu ꞌaigeda. Wahineina ꞌiheꞌaiꞌaihale pwaiya weyahina mwalo hene ꞌihai ta mamwanena simiyamiya gide bolime sebeni.

Ma mwanena ꞌiꞌamasa ta tauna ꞌihiwapeya, ma ꞌimiyamiya ꞌana siga ꞌana bolime ꞌeitipowa. Ma wahineina tauna Hada Heꞌasisi geya ꞌida ꞌebesineya sabwelo ma hinuwana ꞌoidiya, ma Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌalona Yehoba ꞌiheheꞌasisiye, ma ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwanoi hegomaleyega.
Tuta nage ꞌoina wahineina ꞌinaoma ma Yehoba ꞌoina ꞌiloyauwedowa, ma gwamaina weyahina ꞌigwae meYelusalema ꞌoidiya, ꞌigwaeya, “Gwama bewa tauna ꞌada Toꞌabihetena tayamweyamweya.”
Cidi hila Nasaleta ꞌoina
Ma paihowa mabwaiyana silosaloha pwaidiya, toꞌaha gide Yehoba ꞌina loina, ma sihila Galili ꞌoina, weyahina taudi meNasaleta.
Ta gwamaina ꞌimadouwa ta maꞌina waiwai, ma wete maꞌina sanapu, weyahina Yehoba gwamaina ꞌihelauweya madouna.
Gwamaina Yesu toheꞌitao mahetenao sigwaegwae
Bolime ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiya Yesu sinana ma tamana sihanehane Yelusalema, Hataona Guyaina weyahina.
Ma tutaina Yesu ꞌina bolime tuwelo ꞌilobeya ta mahetediu sihaneya guyaina ꞌoina.
Coinega tutaina guyai ꞌigumwala ta mabwaiyadi sisawala ꞌidi gogowa, ma gwamaina Yesu tuwa Yelusalema ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya. Tamana ma sinana geya sisanapu,
ma ꞌidi nuwatuhu ꞌabehega tauna boda mahetenao. Coinega sitautauya ma ꞌana siga ꞌiboiya, ma Yesu siꞌebeseya ꞌidi bodao ma ꞌiyadiyao ꞌoidiya,
ma geya siloba, ꞌoinega sihila Yelusalema, ma nobwa siꞌebeseya,
ta geya siloba ꞌana siga sabwelo ꞌetoi sigumwala, ta silobeya Hada Heꞌasisi* ꞌalona, meYudiya ꞌidi toheꞌitao mahetenao simiyamiya, ꞌihehesagohedi ma wete ꞌihehesilala ꞌoidiya.
Ma taudi ꞌina hemaisao bwebweꞌadi ma dumwaludi sihesagoheya ta mabwaiyadi nuwadi ꞌihenainaida.

Ta wete tutaina tamana ma sinana siꞌiteya nuwadi ꞌihenainaida, ta sinana ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Natugu, toꞌaha weyahina bewa gidemusa ꞌupaihowa ꞌeseya, ta ꞌoinega maꞌima nuwagala tamau baꞌidagu ꞌabesebesego?”
Coinega Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Toꞌaha weyahina wabesebesegau? Nuwana geya wasanapu ꞌagu lobwaina taugu Tamagu ꞌina Hada yamiyamiya?”
Tamana ma sinana geya nuwadi ꞌisabwalena ꞌina gwaeina weyahina.
Coinega mahetenao sihila Nasaleta, ma nobwa ꞌidi gwae ꞌihemata matanediya. Ma hesi sinana ginaula bewa weyahidi ꞌinuwanuwatuhu madouna.
Ma Yesu ꞌihehemadou ta maꞌina sanapu, ꞌoinega Yehoba ꞌiyaliyaya weyahina, ma tomota wete gide ꞌidi ꞌebe yaliyaya.
